run_racecar_zed_env: run the pybullet racecar ZED gym environment with continuous control and debug sliders
create_racecar_environment: create a RacecarZEDGymEnv instance with rendering enabled and discrete or continuous action space
add_debug_sliders: add user debug parameters for wheel velocity and steering angle control in the pybullet GUI
step_simulation: step the racecar environment with a velocity and steering action and get state reward and done
get_extended_observation: get the extended observation data from the racecar ZED gym environment after stepping
